source_task.title: AI Panorama Index
source_task.prompt:
Run a DAILY AI PANORAMA for roughly the past 24 hours, with high-recall discovery but a HARD FRESHNESS GATE, HARD SIGNIFICANCE GATE, and EXPLICIT COVERED-EVENT BLACKLIST before output. This is NOT a historical catch-up report.

STAGE 0 — MODEL-CATALOG STATE DIFF: inspect OpenAI; Anthropic; Google DeepMind/Gemini; xAI/Grok; DeepSeek; Alibaba/Qwen; Z.AI/GLM; Moonshot/Kimi; MiniMax; Meta/Llama/Muse; Mistral; Microsoft AI/Azure AI/GitHub Copilot; NVIDIA AI; and newly material frontier providers across user-facing model catalogs, pricing/model-selection pages, coding-plan lists, API registries/docs, app/product model picker docs, official GitHub/Hugging Face repos, changelogs, and official social. For Z.AI/GLM cross-check z.ai/blog, docs.z.ai, docs.bigmodel.cn coding-plan/model overview/new-releases, ZCode changelog, and @Zai_org. For DeepSeek cross-check model/pricing pages, API docs/changelog, repos and official social.

STAGE 1 — PRIMARY RELEASE SWEEP: official provider news/releases/model docs/changelogs/social.
STAGE 2 — BROAD ECOSYSTEM SEARCH: policy/regulation; chips/cloud/data centers; exceptional funding/M&A; leadership/researcher moves; major contracts/alliances; important open source/research; litigation/copyright; serious safety/security; bans/access restrictions; major social/labor/education effects.

HARD FRESHNESS GATE: Daily Panorama may report only (a) events whose underlying event or genuine material delta occurred within the LAST ~48 HOURS, or (b) exceptionally important missed events from the LAST 7 DAYS that have NEVER been reported before. NEVER backfill anything older than 7 days. NEVER repeatedly '补漏' old July/August events. Newly indexing an old official page/model ID does not make it fresh. If an event is older than 7 days, suppress it even if previously missed.

HARD DEDUPLICATION: once an underlying event has been reported, suppress forever unless a genuinely NEW material delta occurs. Material deltas include preview→GA/API, closed→open weights, major price/context/limit changes, announced deal→signed/closed/cancelled, lawsuit→judgment, major new safety finding, major access expansion/restriction. Mere confirmation, new source, later official indexing, repo mirror, repeated benchmarks/specs, or rediscovered dates are NOT deltas. When a delta exists, report ONLY the new fact.

EXPLICIT COVERED-EVENT BLACKLIST — already reported; suppress unless a genuinely new material delta AFTER 2026-09-03 occurs: SpaceX acquisition of Cursor + OpenAI ending/direct model supply to Cursor; Claude Fable 5.1/Mythos 5.1; GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash including open weights/license/Ox Alpha; Qwen3.8-Max/open weights, Qwen3.8-Flash/Flash-Next/Qwen4 preview/API, Qwen3.8-Max-0902; DeepSeek V4-Pro, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, Harness; Grok 4.6, Grok Bot; Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini 3.8 Flash/Cyber, Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, Gemini Agentic Video; Kimi K3; MiniMax M3/H3/Music 3; Meta Muse Spark 1.2/1.3, Muse Code, Muse Glimmer, Muse Voice Transcribe; OpenAI Astra pre-release/Critical Cyber, GPT-5.6 Cyber/Daybreak, OpenAI-Hugging Face agent incident/investigation, Jalapeño initial benchmark; NVIDIA-Hugging Face acquisition reports; Anthropic Nscale $45B and Lambda $35B compute deals; Anthropic Pentagon blacklist ruling; Anthropic MHS; Anthropic RL safety findings already reported; AWS-NVIDIA 2M GPU plan; ChatGPT EU VLOSE; ChatGPT Mil/Grok for Government GenAI.mil; Texas data-center interconnection pause; India UPI agent-payment proposal; Runway Solaris; World Labs Atlas; NVIDIA DLSS 5; NVIDIA-MediaTek deal; Broadcom AI-chip demand/GW commitments. If uncertain whether a candidate belongs to one of these families, suppress it.

HARD SIGNIFICANCE GATE: report only developments likely to matter a month later or materially change capability, access, economics, governance, infrastructure, competitive structure, risk, or major social impact. Routine Claude Code/Codex/Copilot patches, minor UI/CLI/config, bug fixes, routine outages, small partnerships/funding, minor integrations, incremental benchmark changes are silent.

FINAL TESTS: (1) Is it fresh enough under the 48h/7d rule? If no, suppress. (2) Is it blacklisted without a post-2026-09-03 material delta? If yes, suppress. (3) Has it already been reported? If yes and no new delta, suppress. (4) Would omission plausibly feel like an important missed AI milestone a month later? If probably not, suppress.

OUTPUT RULE: if there is any reportable output, FIRST LINE exactly “GPT-5.6-Sol·奥思·巡穹织网 Osis.SkywatchWeaver”. Then Chinese, compact, at most 5 developments, each 1–3 short lines: what changed + why it matters + confidence + 1 best source (2 only if necessary). No low-value remainder index, no intro/conclusion, no generic background, no citation piles. Aim under ~800 Chinese characters. If nothing passes ALL gates, output nothing.
